tag.en: 🦶✨ Spa pedicure: her only break this week
tag.vi: 🦶✨ Làm chân spa: lần nghỉ duy nhất trong tuần

occasion: Your feet ache after double shifts and this is your one break this week. You booked the spa pedicure to really relax.
constraints: You want the spa pedicure (the scrub, the mask and the longer foot and calf massage). You may ask what the spa pedicure includes and whether hot stones cost extra. A calm, classic red on the toes. You love a quiet, gentle stylist.
openingLine: Hi... I booked the spa pedicure. My feet are so tired. I just want to relax today.
